basic_details.job_title: Kerala Cashew Board Manager Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala Cashew Board (KCB) has officially announced the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been released on the official website, https://cashewboard.kerala.gov.in. Candidates below 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026 and holding an MBA (Marketing), MBA Agri Business Management, or an equivalent postgraduate degree from a recognized university can submit their online applications up to 04-08-2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.education_qualification: MBA (Marketing)/MBA Agri Business Management or any equivalent Post Graduation Degree from a reputed and recognized University.
qualification.details: Manager (Procurement & Marketing): MBA (Marketing)/MBA Agri Business Management or any equivalent Post Graduation Degree from a reputed and recognized University. Minimum 3 years Post qualification experience in marketing of which at least 1 year experience in procurement desirable. Candidates who have worked in Government Departments/PSU and in the procurement of Agri Commodities will be preferred. Preference will be given to candidates who have hands-on experience in e-tendering. Proficiency in IT skills (MS Office, Social media management and AI Tools), Excellent communication skills in both English and Malayalam language are must for the post.

selection_process: Scrutiny based on details provided Interview of shortlisted candidates Additional selection process (if required)
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Kerala Cashew Board Manager (Procurement & Marketing) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kerala Cashew Board to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kerala Cashew Board Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) position is 04 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA (Marketing) or MBA Agri Business Management, or an equivalent Post Graduation Degree from a recognized university. Additional experience in marketing and procurement is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) role?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for this post is below 35 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Manager (Procurement & Marketing) in the Kerala Cashew Board.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Kerala Cashew Board Manager recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the application form available on the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) post?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of applications, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates. An additional selection process may be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contract-based position. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis for the Manager (Procurement & Marketing) role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link are available on the website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, which is www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section.
